name: UXUS Agent Services
description: Pay-per-call tools for AI agents. Headline: one-call risk verdicts, PROCEED / CAUTION / BLOCK with reasons, for any EVM wallet or token ($0.02). Also search, scrape, extract, embed and LLM at $0.01. USDC on Base via x402, no account or API key.

resources.description: LLM chat completion. $0.01 USDC per call on Base, no API key. POST JSON { prompt } or { messages: [{ role, content }] }; optional model (OpenRouter slug) and max_tokens (default 800, max 2000). Falls back across up to 5 models so one outage does not fail the call. Returns { content, model, usage, latency_ms }.

Any URL as clean, LLM-ready content. $0.01 USDC per call on Base, no API key. GET ?url=... (required), format=markdown|text|html (default markdown), max_chars (default 40000, max 120000). Returns { title, description, content, status, truncated, chars, latency_ms }. Non-HTML URLs come back as raw content.

Structured JSON from a web page or text, with exactly the fields you ask for. $0.01 USDC per call on Base, no API key. POST JSON { schema: { field: type, ... } (required), plus url or text }. Returns { data } with your schema's keys (null when a field is not in the source), the model used and latency_ms. Page fetch capped at 10 s, whole call at 45 s, so it never hangs.

Text embeddings. $0.01 USDC per call on Base, no API key. POST JSON { input: a string or up to 64 strings }. Model jina-embeddings-v3, 1024 dimensions. Returns { embeddings (one vector per input), dimensions, count, usage, latency_ms }.

Live web search results. $0.01 USDC per call on Base, no API key. GET ?q=... (required), count 1-20 (default 10), optional country, language, page. Returns results[{ title, url, description, score }], plus Google's answer box, knowledge graph, people-also-ask, related searches and shopping when the Google-backed provider answers (empty on fallback).

query.device: Forwarded to the upstream provider if set. Optional.

resources.description: One call, one verdict: PROCEED, CAUTION or BLOCK for any EVM wallet or token, with the reasons attached. $0.02 USDC per call on Base, no API key or account. GET ?address=0x... (required), chain=base|ethereum, type=wallet|token. Checks the OFAC SDN list (synced daily), scam and phishing lists, and honeypot, tax and mint signals. Returns verdict, a one-line summary, reasons[] strongest first, risk_score 0-100 and sources. Never PROCEED when a source could not be checked.
FREE verdict only: PROCEED / CAUTION / BLOCK, risk_score, risk_level and flags for an EVM wallet or token. The reasons, summary and sources are in /api/risk/pro ($0.02).
Returns every service with its id, method, URL, price, and parameter list in one JSON call — the machine-readable storefront index.
MCP server over JSON-RPC 2.0. Returns tool results inline for free tools; for paid tools returns the x402 endpoint, price, and pay-to address. GET returns server metadata.
Returns the mutable-risk verdict, mutable_risk_score (0-100), can_turn_hostile, and time_to_rug for a token. /api/risk/live/pro adds the per-power breakdown and raw controls.

One call, one verdict on a token's owner powers: PROCEED, CAUTION or BLOCK, with the reasons attached. $0.02 USDC per call on Base, no API key. GET ?address=0x... (token contract, required), chain=base|ethereum. Reads the chain directly: owner, pause switch, pending owner, upgradeable proxy. Tells you whether the owner can still pause, upgrade or rug it. Returns verdict, a one-line summary, reasons[] strongest first, can_turn_hostile, time_to_rug and the raw controls.

Same one-call verdict as /api/risk/pro (PROCEED / CAUTION / BLOCK, summary, reasons strongest first), served through the x402 v2 Bazaar resource server. $0.02 USDC on Base, settled only after a successful answer.
Returns the newest DEX pools on Base/Ethereum (pair, token address, liquidity, FDV, 24h volume, age, flags), each with a riskCheck link into /api/risk/live.

Returns one normalized envelope — address, chain, chain_detected, exists, risk_score, risk_level, verdict, flags, entity, upgrade — for any EVM 0x or XRPL classic r-address, chain auto-detected from the format.

query.address: required — EVM 0x address or XRPL classic r-address

resources.description: Returns { is_known, label, category } for an EVM address — what it IS (not who owns it). category is one of sanctioned, mixer, exchange, bridge, dex_router, scam, drainer, phishing, flagged, token_contract, protocol, unknown. "sanctioned" comes solely from the OFAC SDN list (same source as /api/risk); a non-OFAC blocklist hit is "flagged". Sourced from OFAC, ScamSniffer, MEW, eth-labels and curated Base/Tornado sets. Never guesses.

Bidirectional name <-> address resolution for ENS (name.eth) and Basenames (name.base.eth) via public RPC + the resolver contracts directly. Reverse records are forward-verified against the input address (anti-spoofing). Auto-detects direction. Returns { query, kind, namespace, chain, resolved, address, name, sources, lookup }. XRPL .xrp names are detected but return resolved:false (no canonical registry).

query.q: required — an ENS/Basename name, an EVM 0x address, or an XRPL classic r-address

resources.description: Wallet caller ID for wallet messaging (XMTP, Push): should this wallet be answered. Composes entity attribution + risk score + on-chain history + forward-verified name into ANSWER | SCREEN | BLOCK with reasons[] and a confidence flag. BLOCK on sanctioned/drainer/phishing/scam/mixer or risk verdict BLOCK; ANSWER on a known exchange/dex_router/protocol or a verified ENS/Basename with risk PROCEED; SCREEN is the default for unknown addresses. confidence 'low' means an input could not be checked — degrades to SCREEN, never guesses.

Per-user PRIVATE wallet blocklist — the first stateful product in the store. Your block never affects another user's results (no shared reputation, no aggregate scoring). Ownership is proved by signature, not an API key: GET /api/shield/nonce?owner=0x..., sign the returned message (EIP-191; v1 verifies EOA/ECDSA only — no ERC-1271/Safe yet), POST /api/shield/session { owner, signature } for a 60-minute bearer token. Then GET /api/shield/check?address=0x...&chain=base with that token returns { blocked, source, recommendation, reasons[], entity, name }: precedence is sanctioned entity (hard stop — cannot be allowlisted) > your allowlist > your manual block > auto-BLOCK from caller ID > the caller-ID recommendation. Writes: POST /api/shield/block|unblock|allow|unallow { owner, signature, address } (fresh nonce + signature each; the message binds the action and target). GET /api/shield/list and GET /api/shield/stats (7d / 30d / 90d, by action and entity category) also take the bearer token. Every /check is logged; shield_events are pruned daily (cron + opportunistic) so nothing older than 90 days is kept — 90-day retention, stated not buried. Free in v1.

query.address: required 0x EVM address to check against your list
